authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL rakta explicitly gives blood; Tulpule Old Marathi p.579 entry 2 gives ragata blood and explicitly identifies Sanskrit rakta as its etymon, with reciprocal rakta/ragata comparison at p.578 entry 5. This directly documents the epenthetic voiced ragat type, rather than deriving it from a red-colour gloss alone. The selected survey rogat/rəgəṭ/rekeṭ/rekṭ/rakṭo/ṛakto/rəkhət/rakt a blood forms are grouped provisionally in this family. Source epenthetic vowels, stop voicing, aspiration, retroflexion and spacing remain unchanged. Learned or cross-IA transmission is unresolved; no claim of an Old Marathi loan to every lect is made. Exact response: ṛakto.
